title: 第6章  父皇的PUA：大将军被忽悠瘸了！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
赵辰安低头，看着怀中少女那泛红的鼻尖和湿润的睫毛。
他捧着乌兰雪的小脸，用指腹轻轻抹去她眼角的湿意。
他的话语郑重，带着不容置疑的肯定。
乌兰雪用力地点头，将脸颊在他温暖的掌心蹭了蹭，然后踮起脚尖，主动献上了自己生涩而热烈的吻。
赵辰安微微用力，将她拦腰抱起！
直奔那新婚后尚未整理的婚房而去！
……（老规矩，省略内容加入书架可以展开！）
与此同时，皇宫深处，御书房。
空气中弥漫着一股淡淡的龙涎香，混合着墨香。
本该是安神静气的地方，此刻却充斥着一股压抑不住的火气。
“陛下！”
一声粗犷的暴喝打破了宁静。
车骑大将军李擎苍，这位刚刚率军击溃天狼部落，威震北疆的猛将。
此刻却连甲胄都未卸下，就这么风风火火地闯了进来。
他那张饱经风霜的国字脸涨得通红，浓密的络腮胡都在微微颤抖。
“末将斗胆，敢问陛下，那道赐婚的圣旨，是……是真的吗？”
他站在书案前，因为情绪激动，连自称都有些混乱。
御座之上，身穿龙袍的赵道霆缓缓放下手中的朱笔，抬起头。
他那张不怒自威的脸上，看不出半点波澜，只是平静地回视着自己最信任的这位将军。
“是朕下的旨。”

赵道霆的回答云淡风轻，却带着一种不容置疑的肯定。
李擎苍胸膛剧烈起伏，显然是在极力压抑着什么。
“陛下！您知道的，小女青鸾……她……她不是寻常的大家闺秀！”
他急切地辩解着，声音都有些发紧。
“她自幼随我习武，天赋异禀，如今不过双十年华，便已成功开辟道宫，踏入了道宫境初期！”
“如此天资，就算配与那些寻常天骄也未必逊色！可您……您却将她赐给十六皇子做……做侧妃？”
说到最后两个字，李擎苍的牙齿都咬得咯咯作响。
那可是他李擎苍的掌上明珠！
是整个大周王朝都赫赫有名的将门虎女！
嫁给那个除了脸蛋一无是处的纨绔废物当侧妃？
这简直比让他战死沙场还要难受！
赵道霆听着他的抱怨，脸上依旧没什么变化，只是端起手边的茶盏，轻轻吹了吹浮沫。
然后，他才慢悠悠地开口。
“说完了？”
李擎苍一怔。
“说完了，就该朕问你了。”
赵道霆放下茶盏，发出“嗒”的一声轻响。
“在你李大将军看来，朕的儿子，配不上你的女儿？”
这一句话，平平淡淡，却让李擎苍浑身剧震。
刚刚还满腔的怒火和委屈，瞬间被一股彻骨的寒意浇灭。

他整个人都僵住了。
一股冷汗，瞬间从他的额头渗了出来。
“不……不是！末将绝无此意！”
李擎苍“噗通”一声单膝跪地，高大的身躯伏在地上，声音都带上了颤抖。
“陛下的皇子，乃是真龙血脉，金枝玉叶。”
“小女能嫁入皇家，是她几辈子修来的福分！末将……末将岂敢有半点不敬！”
他慌忙解释，生怕说慢了半个字。
赵道霆居高临下地看着他，没有让他起来的意思。
“那你是什么意思？”
“末将……末将是说……十六皇子他……”
李擎苍卡住了。
后面的话，他无论如何也说不出口。
说十六皇子无法开辟苦海，是个修行路上的废物？
说十六皇子终日游手好闲，是皇城里人尽皆知的头号纨绔？
当着人家亲爹的面，数落他儿子的不是？
他李擎苍是莽，不是蠢！
他可以当着皇帝陛下面前说自己女儿的各种好。
却不能说十六皇子一个“不”字！
不然就是真在找死！
看着他那副憋屈又不敢言的样子，赵道霆心中暗笑。

这憨货。
他本想稍微透露一两句，安抚一下这位爱将的心。
但转念一想，赵道霆改变了主意。
为什么要解释。
朕是皇帝！
他忽然换了个话题，声音变得深沉。
“李擎苍。”
“末将在！”
李擎苍一个激灵，头埋得更低了。
“你对朕，可还忠诚？”
这个问题来得莫名其妙，但李擎苍没有丝毫犹豫，斩钉截铁地回答：
“末将这条命都是陛下的！只要陛下一声令下，无论是刀山火海，还是十万敌军，末将绝不皱一下眉头！”
赵道霆点了点头，似乎很满意。
“很好。”
他停顿了一下，又问。
“那你觉得，朕会害你吗？”
李擎苍猛地抬头。
他看着御座上那个熟悉的身影，思绪瞬间回到了几十年前。
那时，他还只是御前的一个小小侍卫，而眼前的陛下，也还只是普通的皇子之一。
是陛下一手将自己从侍卫提拔为偏将，再到将军，最后封为车骑大将军，位极人臣。

这份知遇之恩，这份君臣情谊，早已超脱了寻常。
李擎苍虎目一热，声音变得沉重而坚定。
“陛下待末将恩重如山，知根知底，末将信自己，更信陛下！陛下绝不会加害末将分毫！”
“呵。”
赵道霆笑了。
他从御座上站起身，走到李擎苍面前，亲自将他扶了起来。
“既然你信朕，也信朕不会害你。”
赵道霆拍了拍他坚实的臂膀，脸上挂着一丝玩味的笑意。
“那你还在这里跟朕唠叨什么？”
“滚回去，洗干净脖子……不是，是洗干净你女儿，等着七日后出嫁就行了。”
“朕的安排，自有深意。”
李擎苍就这么被赵道霆连扶带推地弄出了御书房。
直到殿门在他身后缓缓关上，他高大的身躯还僵在原地，脑子里一片空白。
有什么深意？
把一个道宫境的天才闺女，嫁给一个开不了苦海的废物，这能有什么深意？
李擎苍甩了甩脑袋，只觉得自己的脑子完全不够用了。
就在他满心茫然，准备离开之时，一道急切的身影从走廊的另一头冲了过来。
“李将军！李将军请留步！”
来人正是三皇子赵辰宇。
他面容憔悴，双目布满血丝，显然是一夜未眠，此刻看到李擎苍，就像是看到了救命稻草。

“李将军，父皇他……”
赵辰宇冲到李擎苍面前，刚要说话。
然而，李擎苍只是用那双铜铃大眼瞥了他一下，什么话都没说。
他现在满脑子都是陛下的“深意”，哪里有空理会这个失魂落魄的皇子。
于是，在赵辰宇错愕的注视下，这位车骑大将军，就这么迈开大步，直接从他身边走了过去。
连一个停顿都没有。
甲胄碰撞，发出铿锵之声，渐行渐远。
赵辰宇伸出的手，就那么僵在了半空中。
他整个人都傻了。
风吹过空旷的宫廷走廊，卷起几片落叶，也卷走了他脸上最后的一丝血色。

Zhao Chenan lowered his head and looked at the red nose and moist eyelashes of the girl in his arms.
He held Wu Lanxue's little face and gently wiped away the moisture from the corners of her eyes with his fingertips.
His words were solemn and filled with unquestionable certainty.
Wu Lanxue nodded vigorously, rubbed her cheek against his warm palm, then stood on tiptoes and offered her raw and passionate kiss.
Zhao Chenan used a little force to pick her up by the waist!
Go straight to the wedding room that has not been tidied up after the wedding!
...(Old rule, omit content and add it to the bookshelf to expand it!)
At the same time, deep in the palace, there was the imperial study room.
There was a faint scent of ambergris in the air, mixed with the scent of ink.
This place should have been a place of peace and tranquility, but now it was filled with an irrepressible anger.
"Your Majesty!"
A rough shout broke the silence.
Chariot and Cavalry General Li Qingcang, this fierce general who had just led his army to defeat the Tianlang tribe and shocked the northern frontier.
At this moment, he didn't even take off his armor, and just barged in like a storm.
His weather-beaten face was flushed red, and his thick beard was trembling slightly.
"I am brave enough to ask Your Majesty, is that imperial edict granting marriage... is it true?"
He stood in front of the desk, and because of his excitement, he was a little confused even when he called himself.
On the throne, Zhao Daoting, who was wearing a dragon robe, slowly put down the ink pen in his hand and raised his head.
There was no trace of emotion on his calm and calm face, he just looked back calmly at the general he trusted most.
"It's my decree."
Zhao Daoting's answer was calm and gentle, but it contained an unquestionable affirmation.
Li Qingcang's chest rose and fell violently, obviously trying to suppress something.
"Your Majesty! You know, the little girl Qingluan...she...she is not an ordinary lady!"
He argued eagerly, his voice a little tight.
"She has been practicing martial arts with me since she was a child. She is extremely talented. Now, in just twenty years, she has successfully opened a Tao Palace and entered the early stage of the Tao Palace realm!"
"Such a talent, even if it matches those of ordinary geniuses, it may not be inferior! But you... you gave her to the sixteenth prince to be... a concubine?"
Li Qingcang's teeth chattered when he said the last two words.
That is the apple of his eye, Li Qingcang!
She is a famous general and tiger girl throughout the Zhou Dynasty!
Marry that dandy good-for-nothing and become a concubine?
This is simply more uncomfortable than letting him die in battle!
Zhao Daoting listened to his complaints, his face remained unchanged, he just picked up the tea cup at hand and blew the foam gently.
Then, he spoke slowly.
"Finished?"
Li Qingcang was startled.
"That's it, it's time for me to ask you."
Zhao Daoting put down the tea cup and made a soft "tap" sound.
"In your opinion, General Li, my son is not worthy of your daughter?"
This sentence, so indifferent, made Li Qingcang tremble all over.
The anger and grievance that had just filled his heart was instantly extinguished by a bone-chilling chill.
His whole body froze.
A cold sweat broke out from his forehead instantly.
"No...no! The general never meant this!"
Li Qingcang knelt down on one knee with a "pop" sound, his tall body lying on the ground, and his voice was trembling.
"Your Majesty's prince has the blood of a true dragon, and he has golden branches and jade leaves."
"My daughter's ability to marry into the royal family is a blessing she has earned over many lifetimes! General... how dare you be disrespectful at all!"
He hurriedly explained, fearing that he would be half a word too late.
Zhao Daoting looked at him condescendingly, with no intention of letting him get up.
"What do you mean?"
"The last general...the last general means...the sixteenth prince..."
Li Qingcang was stuck.
He couldn't say the rest anyway.
To say that the Sixteenth Prince cannot open up the sea of ​​suffering and is a waste on the path of spiritual practice?
Are you saying that the Sixteenth Prince is idle all day long and is the most well-known playboy in the imperial city?Isn't he the one who scolded his son in front of his own father?
Li Qingcang is reckless, not stupid!
He can say all kinds of good things about his daughter in front of His Majesty the Emperor.
But you can't say "no" to the sixteenth prince!
Otherwise, you are really looking for death!
Seeing his aggrieved and afraid-to-speak expression, Zhao Daoting smiled to himself.
This idiot.
He originally wanted to reveal a few words to appease his beloved general.
But after thinking about it, Zhao Daoting changed his mind.
Why explain.
I am the emperor!
He suddenly changed the topic and his voice became deeper.
"Li Qingcang."
"The general is here!"
Li Qingcang was agitated and lowered his head.
"Are you still loyal to me?"
This question came out of nowhere, but Li Qingcang didn't hesitate at all and answered decisively:
"This general's life belongs to His Majesty! As long as His Majesty gives the order, no matter it is a mountain of swords, a sea of fire, or a hundred thousand enemy troops, the General will never frown!"
Zhao Daoting nodded, seemingly satisfied.
"Very good."
He paused and asked again.
"Then do you think I will harm you?"
Li Qingcang raised his head suddenly.
He looked at the familiar figure on the throne, and his thoughts instantly returned to decades ago.
At that time, he was just a small guard in front of the emperor, and the majesty in front of him was just one of the ordinary princes.
It was His Majesty who single-handedly promoted himself from bodyguard to general, then to general, and finally to general of chariots and cavalry, a position that was extremely popular.
This kind of kindness, this friendship between the king and his ministers, has already transcended the ordinary.
Li Qingcang's eyes heated up, and his voice became heavy and firm.
"Your Majesty is as generous as a mountain to my general. He knows his roots well. He believes in himself and even more in Your Majesty! Your Majesty will never harm this general in the slightest!"
"Heh."
Zhao Daoting smiled.
He stood up from the throne, walked to Li Qingcang, and helped him up personally.
"Since you believe in me, you also believe that I will not harm you."
Zhao Daoting patted his solid arm with a playful smile on his face.
"Then why are you still nagging me here?"
"Go back and wash your neck... No, I'm just washing your daughter and waiting for her to get married in seven days."
"My arrangement has deep meaning."
Li Qingcang was helped and pushed out of the imperial study room by Zhao Daoting.
Until the palace door slowly closed behind him, his tall body was still frozen in place, and his mind was blank.
What's the meaning?
What's the meaning of marrying a talented girl from the Taoist palace to a loser who can't get rid of the sea of ​​suffering?
Li Qingcang shook his head, feeling that his brain was completely exhausted.
Just when he was confused and ready to leave, an eager figure rushed over from the other end of the corridor.
"General Li! General Li, please stay!"
The visitor was none other than the Third Prince Zhao Chenyu.
His face was haggard and his eyes were bloodshot. He had obviously not slept all night. Seeing Li Qingcang at this moment was like seeing a life-saving straw.
"General Li, Father, he..."
Zhao Chenyu rushed to Li Qingcang and was about to speak.
However, Li Qingcang just glanced at him with those big copper bell eyes and said nothing.
His mind was now filled with His Majesty's "deep meaning", and he had no time to pay attention to this lost prince.
So, under Zhao Chenyu's astonished gaze, the cavalry general took long strides and walked directly past him.
Not even a pause.
The armor collided, making a clanging sound, and gradually moved away.
Zhao Chenyu's outstretched hand just froze in mid-air.
He was completely stunned.
The wind blew through the empty palace corridor, picking up a few fallen leaves and taking away the last trace of blood from his face.
